org.primer.llm.usage: Tier-1 breakpoint primitive scale. Has no design meaning of its own, only its position in the ramp — consumed exclusively through tier-2 semantic aliases (theme.*). Do not read one of these directly from component code. Consumed by al-scss-vars as Sass breakpoint() function inputs, not as CSS custom properties — do not expect a `--al-breakpoint-*` var() reader.
